title: Refund Policy - Transparent & Fair | Dreemy AI
text: Dreemy AI Refund & Payment Policy 💎 Pure "Pay-As-You-Go" Model Dreemy AI operates differently. We have NO subscriptions , NO auto-renewals , and NO hidden fees . You only pay for what you want, when you want it. 1. Zero Cancellation Hassle Because we do not use recurring subscriptions, there is nothing to cancel . You never have to worry about forgetting to turn off auto-renew. Once you purchase a credit package, that is the only charge you will see. If you wish to stop using Dreemy AI, simply stop buying credits. 2. Refund Eligibility Criteria We want you to be satisfied with our AI generation quality. We offer refunds on credit packages if the following strict conditions are met within the guarantee window: ✅ Refund Requirements Checklist To qualify for a refund, your account must meet ALL of the following criteria: Window: Request submitted within 7 days of the original purchase. Chat Usage: Fewer than 30 messages sent post-purchase. Media Usage: Image/Video generation cost must be ≤ 80 credits . Bot Creation: Fewer than 5 custom bots created. Note: If your usage exceeds these limits (e.g., generating >80 credits worth of images), the service is considered "consumed" and is non-refundable due to the GPU costs incurred. 3. Non-Refundable Scenarios Refunds will not be granted in the following situations: Requests made more than 7 days after purchase. Accounts that have exceeded the usage limits listed above. Accounts terminated for violating our Terms of Service (e.g., generating illegal content, deepfakes, or harassment). "Change of mind" requests after substantial usage. 4. How to Request a Refund If you meet the eligibility criteria, please follow these steps: Email our billing team at [email protected] . Subject Line: "Refund Request - [Your Username]" Include: Your account email, date of purchase, and the credit package name. Our team will review your usage logs and respond within 7 business days . Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method (e.g., credit card statement) within 5-10 days depending on your bank. 5. Policy Updates Dreemy AI reserves the right to update this policy to reflect changes in our service or costs. Continued use of the platform implies acceptance of the current terms.
